Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১) If 3 spiders make 3 webs in 3 days, then 1 spider will make 1 web in how many days?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question:  If 3 spiders make 3 webs in 3 days, then 1 spider will make 1 web in how many days?

Solution: 
3 spiders can make 3 webs in 3 days,
3 spiders can make 1 webs in 3/3 days,
1 spiders can make 1 webs in (3 × 3)/3 = 3 days

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ২) A can do a work in 15 days and B in 20 days. If they work on it together for 4 days, then the fraction of the work that is left is:
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: A can do a work in 15 days and B in 20 days. If they work on it together for 4 days, then the fraction of the work that is left is:

Solution: 
The work rate of A is 1/15 (since A can complete the work in 15 days).
The work rate of B is 1/20​ (since B can complete the work in 20 days).

In 4 days they complete = 4{(1/15) + (1/20)}
= 4 × 7/60
= 7/15

 then the fraction of the work that is left is = 1 - (7/15)
= (15 - 7)/15
= 8/15

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৩) When Rakib, Piyash and Niloy complete a task, Rakib and Piyash together do 70% of the work and Piyash and Niloy together do 50% of the work. who is the most efficient?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: When Rakib, Piyash and Niloy complete a task, Rakib and Piyash together do 70% of the work and Piyash and Niloy together do 50% of the work. who is the most efficient?

Solution: 
রাকিব, পিয়াস একসাথে ৭০% কাজ করে।
পিয়াস,  নিলয় একসাথে করে ৫০%
রাকিব, পিয়াস ও নিলয় মিলে করে ১০০% কাজ 

পিয়াস করে = ৭০% + ৫০% - ১০০% কাজ 
= ২০% 

নিলয় করে  = ৫০% - ২০% 
= ৩০%

রাকিব করে = ৭০% - ২০% 
= ৫০% 

অর্থাৎ, রাকিব সবচেয়ে দক্ষ।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৪) 18 men bind 900 books in 10 days. Find how many binders will be required to bind 600 books in 12 days?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: 18 men bind 900 books in 10 days. Find how many binders will be required to bind 600 books in 12 days?

Solution: 
To bind 900 books in 10 days binders needed 18 men 
To bind 1 books in 1 days binders needed 180/900 men 
To bind 600 books in 12 days binders needed (180 × 600)/(900 × 12) men
= 10 men

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৫) Piyal and Belal together can complete a work in 3 days. They start together but after 2 days, Belal left the work. If the work is completed after two more days, Belal alone could do the work in how many days?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: Piyal and Belal together can complete a work in 3 days. They start together but after 2 days, Belal left the work. If the work is completed after two more days, Belal alone could do the work in how many days?

Solution:
(Piyal + Belal)'s one day's work = 1/3 part
(Piyal + Belal) works 2 days together = 2/3 part
Remaining work = 1- 2/3
= 1/3 part

1/3 part of work is completed by Piyal in two days
Hence, one day's work of Piyal = 1/6 part

Then, one day's work of Belal = 1/3 - 1/6 = 1/6
So, Belal alone can complete the whole work in 6 days.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৮) If 8 men can reap 40 hectares in 12 days, then how many hectares can 30 men reap in 20 days?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: If 8 men can reap 40 hectares in 12 days, then how many hectares can 30 men reap in 20 days?

Solution: 
8 men can reap  in 12 days 40 hectares
1 men can reap  in 1 days  40/(12 × 8) hectares
30 men reap in 20 days = (40 × 600)/96
= 250 hectares

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৯) A garrison of ‘n’ men had enough food to last for 30 days. After 10 days, 50 more men joined them. If the food now lasted for 16 days, what is the value of n?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: A garrison of ‘n’ men had enough food to last for 30 days. After 10 days, 50 more men joined them. If the food now lasted for 16 days, what is the value of n?

Solution: 
After 10 days, the food for n men is there for 20 days.
This food can be eaten by (n + 50) men in 16 days.

So,
20n = 16(n + 50)
⇒ 20n - 16n = 800
⇒ 4n = 800
∴n = 200

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১০) Joy can knit a pair of socks in 3 days. Belal can knit the same pair of socks in 9 days. If they are knitting together, then in how many days will they knit two pairs of socks?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: Joy can knit a pair of socks in 3 days. Belal can knit the same pair of socks in 9 days. If they are knitting together, then in how many days will they knit two pairs of socks?

Solution: 
They knit in one day = (1/3) + (1/9)
= 4/9 days

They knit a pair of socks in 9/4 days
they knit two pairs of socks in (9 × 2)/4 days 
= 9/2 days

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৪) The mess charges for 35 students for 24 days in Tk 6300. In how many days will the mess charges be Tk 3375 for 25 students?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: The mess charges for 35 students for 24 days in Tk 6300. In how many days will the mess charges be Tk 3375 for 25 students?

Solution: 
Let C be the daily mess charge per student.
Given that mess charges for 35 students for 24 days is Tk 6300, the daily cost per student is = 6300/(35 × 24)
= 7.5 

Now, to find how many days mess charges will be Tk 3375 for 25 students, we can use the daily cost per student (C):

The total mess charges for 25 students in D days is 3375 = 25 × C × D
⇒ D = 3375/(25 × 7.5)
= 18

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৫) 76 ladies complete a job in 33 days. Due to some reason, some ladies did not join the work and therefore it was completed in 44 days. The number of ladies who did not report for the work is-
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: 76 ladies complete a job in 33 days. Due to some reason, some ladies did not join the work and therefore it was completed in 44 days. The number of ladies who did not report for the work is- 

Solution: 
Let L be the rate of work per lady. 

the total work = 76L × 33 

Let,  with x ladies absent, the total work is = (76 - x)L × 44

 76L × 33 = (76 - x)L × 44
⇒ 76 × 33 = 76 × 44 - 44L 
⇒ 44L = 76 × 44 - 76 × 33 = 76 × 11 
⇒ L = 19
